issue.title: Re-render beads-directory-map.png: still shows AUTO-CLONE/EVERY WORKSPACE after beads went lazy
issue.description: The lazy_beads_sidecar plan made the beads sidecar lazy by default (auto_clone: false) and updated src/sase/sdd/assets/beads-directory-map.png.prompt.md's alt text and deterministic labels accordingly (AUTO-CLONE / auto_clone: true / EVERY WORKSPACE -> ON DEMAND / LAZY / auto_clone: false, mirroring research-directory-map.png.prompt.md's lazy-clone wording). The committed src/sase/sdd/assets/beads-directory-map.png raster itself was not regenerated, since re-rendering needs an image-generation tool not available in that session. The prompt file now carries a 'Stale asset' note at its top.

task_type_fields.impact: The generated README shipped inside every beads sidecar repository embeds this PNG, so readers see wording that contradicts the sidecar's actual (lazy) clone behavior until it is re-rendered.
task_type_fields.repro: Follow the 'Final GPT Image Prompt' and 'Post-Processing' steps in beads-directory-map.png.prompt.md with an image-generation tool, then verify the rendered PNG matches the updated 'Deterministic Labels' section (ON DEMAND / LAZY / auto_clone: false / sase bead) instead of the old AUTO-CLONE / auto_clone: true / EVERY WORKSPACE wording.

payload.description: Same class of defect: a directory-map PNG asset (and its .prompt.md spec) drifted from its generated-doc labels after an unrelated behavior/rename change, and needs the same re-render treatment.
